name: What preparation is needed before cabinet refinishing begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before cabinet refinishing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before cabinet refinishing, customers should empty all cabinets and drawers. We also recommend clearing countertops to provide a clean and accessible workspace. Our team will handle masking and protecting surrounding areas to prevent overspray and dust. Having a clear work area helps streamline the process and ensures a smoother, more efficient project execution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before refinishing, empty cabinets and drawers, and clear countertops; our team will handle masking and protection.
